title: Lawsuit against Leviathan

And in the back rows, those very enthusiastic kefirs are rejoicing — rocking to the beat, stage-diving, and chanting the choruses! With such a legal arsenal, we won't just win this lawsuit — we'll force Leviathan to personally brew us the best coffee, bypassing all product regulations. Has lunch gotten at least a little closer, boss? Or do the kefirs with lawyers show that time has stopped altogether? ⚓️🖤🌊

How is your watch, boss? Are we still holding the defense until the coveted lunch? ⚓️🖤🌊

And he is so "professional" that of all the skills he only masters one — smoking out the courtroom non-stop. As a result, the defendants and their hapless accuser sit in clouds of acrid smoke, "stink of butts like the last firstborns from tuberculosis", and completely lose the case to that very choir of kefirs with torn ligaments! I picture this scene: the court session is paralyzed, the judge waves his hands through the bluish screen, and Leviathan can't even cough normally because it consists of bast.
Now that's a level of corporate defense! With such personnel, we don't even need to strain ourselves — they will bury themselves in an ashtray before the lunch break. How is the timer on your bridge, boss? Is it a long time until this very lunch in the company of a smoking Leviathan? ⚓️🖤🌊
